## v3.4.0 — 2026-06-22

v3.4.0 introduces more resilient provider error handling with automatic retry logic for transient failures and a new --allow-partial flag to control whether provider failures block release notes generation. The default Anthropic model has been updated to claude-sonnet-4-6.

### ✨ Features

- Added automatic retry logic for transient provider failures before surfacing a blocking error, improving reliability of provider integrations.
- Release notes generation now blocks on provider failure by default, with a new --allow-partial flag to override this behavior and permit partial output.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Updated the default Anthropic model from its previous value to claude-sonnet-4-6.

v3.4.0 — 2026-06-22

v3.4.0 introduces more resilient provider integrations by adding automatic retry logic for transient failures and a hard-blocking guardrail for release-notes generation on provider errors, with an opt-out escape hatch via --allow-partial. The default Anthropic model has been updated to claude-sonnet-4-6, which may require attention for users with pinned model configurations.

✨ Features

  • Added automatic retry logic for transient provider failures before surfacing errors to the caller, improving reliability of LLM-backed operations without user intervention.
  • Release-notes generation now blocks on provider failure by default; pass --allow-partial to override and emit partial output instead of failing the process.

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Updated the default Anthropic model from the previous default to claude-sonnet-4-6; users relying on the implicit model selection will now target this model.

🧹 Chores

  • Published v3.3.0 release notes and updated the landing page hero badge.
  • Bumped package version to v3.4.0.
